call_points.text: Management expects some margin improvement in FY27, calling FY26 the bottom.
FY27 capex guided at ₹80-90 Cr, mainly the Dahej new-product plant and engineering projects.
Kurkumbh project delayed from Q1FY27 to the beginning of Q2FY27; mechanical completion due end-June.
Plants run at 60-85% utilisation; enough capacity for the next few years without new investment in existing products.
Ammonia doubled from about ₹50/kg to over ₹100/kg; the increase was passed on to customers.
March margin gain came from cheap raw-material inventory and is not sustainable, per management.
Pharma is 50-60% of sales and agro 15-20%, together about 70-75%.
Aarti's new methylamine plant creates overcapacity; four players now compete in that chain.
About a dozen R&D projects are at various stages; only 1-2 may reach commercialisation.
